COVERAGE_SUMMARY: 5 UI-testable promotion stories mapped to 10 business checks and 8 coverage rows. 3 non-UI/evaluation stories are excluded from direct business execution.
STORIES_IN_SCOPE:
G2-25007 | FE: Promotions totals display | Done
G2-24502 | FE: Free Shipping Promotions | Closed
G2-24259 | FE: Catalogue-level Promotions | Done
G2-24257 | FE: Cart-level Promotions | Done
G2-24255 | FE: France & California Discount Pricing | New
STORIES_EXCLUDED:
G2-25003 | BE: Spike | Promotions | Evaluation/backend-only discovery story
G2-25000 | FE: Spike | Promotions | Evaluation and discovery notes without deterministic AC
G2-24503 | BE: Free Shipping Promotions | Backend implementation story not directly executable by business users
OUT_OF_SCOPE: Backend promotion-engine internals, promo rule authoring in admin tools, infrastructure integrations, and code-level diagnostics outside storefront business-user execution.
DEV_EVIDENCE: GitHub key lookups were executed for all 5 in-scope stories (G2-25007, G2-24502, G2-24259, G2-24257, G2-24255) and returned no direct PR/commit hits. Jira-link fallback scans of description/comments/issuelinks found no GitHub PR/commit URLs. Evidence status: Evidence Unavailable for all in-scope stories.
GAPS_SUMMARY: Most in-scope stories contain sparse or empty Acceptance Criteria sections and rely on story-goal prose; G2-24257 comment thread explicitly highlights open behavior questions (threshold ownership, segment eligibility, and placement). Regional legal rules in G2-24255 require explicit business confirmation for US vs California scope boundary.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Order-level promotion discount is displayed in Shopping Bag
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Add eligible products to cart and trigger a cart-level promotion condition. Inspect order summary in Shopping Bag.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Order-level discount appears with clear label and monetary impact.
Order total is reduced consistently with the applied promotion.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Line-item promotion details are visible for affected products
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use a basket containing an item with catalog-level discount and inspect line item rows in Shopping Bag and Checkout.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Original and discounted prices are distinguishable on affected items.
Promotion labeling/message is visible on each affected line item.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer can apply a valid promo code and see confirmation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Enter a valid promo code in Shopping Bag and submit. Continue into Checkout to confirm persisted state.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Promo code applies successfully and confirmation state is visible.
Adjusted total remains consistent after navigation to Checkout.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer can remove an applied promo code
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From a basket with an active promo code, use remove action and re-check totals and labels.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Promo code is removed from visible applied state.
Totals and promotion labels revert according to base pricing rules.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Invalid promo code shows a user-facing error without breaking flow
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Submit an invalid or expired code and observe cart-level behavior and messaging.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Clear error feedback is shown to customer.
Checkout/cart remains usable with no corrupted totals.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Free-shipping promotions display FREE when shipping cost is zero
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use a scenario where shipping method cost becomes zero after promotion eligibility and inspect Shopping Bag, Checkout, and confirmation pages.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Shipping price displays FREE consistently when cost is zero.
No shipping promo element is shown when no shipping method is assigned.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Promotion-adjusted totals stay consistent through Shopping Bag, Checkout, and Order Confirmation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Progress end-to-end from bag to order completion in a promoted basket and compare subtotal/discount/total amounts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No unexpected total drift is observed between pages.
Order Confirmation reflects the same applied promotion outcomes as checkout.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: France and California discount display rules are honored
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run representative discount scenarios for FR and CA contexts and inspect color/strikethrough behavior before and after sale-window boundaries.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Display formatting matches documented regional rules for FR and CA.
No contradictory visual pricing state is shown for the tested context.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Core promotion behavior is consistent across both target storefronts
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat critical promo-code and pricing checks on both acceptance URLs with equivalent baskets.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Critical promotion outcomes are consistent across both brands.
No brand-specific blocker appears for core promotion flow.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Minimum spend and customer-segment eligibility behaviors are user-visible and predictable
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Test one basket below threshold and one above threshold, including a segment-restricted code where available.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Eligibility state changes are reflected clearly to the user.
Ineligible baskets do not silently apply restricted promotions.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Confluence mapping shows multiple price-field variants (original, markdown, promotion, adjusted).
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Compare rendered price elements in UI against expected transitions from original to markdown to promotion-adjusted values.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: UI communicates price evolution clearly without conflicting labels or amounts.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Totals-display story provides intent but not explicit AC scenario set.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Totals remain stable and transparent for customers under combined promotion conditions.
